summary: Through one night the circle argues whether a friend can be stopped. By dawn the only road left has a name: the port, and the craft that can leave it.

segments.ja: リヴァイの息のあと、輪は夜の話に入ります。入る顔は、ハンジ、ジャン、アニ、ライナー、マガト、イェレナ、ガビです。です。ミカサは端に残り、アルミンは言葉の側にいます。いる全員が、同じ問いを別の言葉で持っています。持っている問いは、エレンを止めるか、です。止めるという言葉は、殺すに近いので、最初は誰も完成させません。完成させない夜が、輪の長さになります。
segments.en: After Levi's breath, the circle enters the night's talk. The faces that enter are Hange, Jean, Annie, Reiner, Magath, Yelena, and Gabi. They are. Mikasa remains at the edge, and Armin is on the side of words. Everybody who is there holds the same question in different words. The question they hold is whether to stop Eren. Because the word stop is close to kill, nobody completes it at first. The night of not completing it becomes the length of the circle.

segments.en: Jean sets Sasha's plate at the center of this night. The plate he sets is not a procedure of a meal. It is not. segments.ja: イェレナは、夜の輪で計画を下げません。下げない内容は、行進が島の生存だ、です。生存の名を、彼女はジークとエレンの接触に結びます。結ぶ笑顔を、ハンジは息の夜から続いて信用しません。信用しない問いを、イェレナは感情だとして退けます。退ける態度が、輪の温度を一度下げます。下げる温度でも、彼女は席を立ちません。立たないことが、この夜の奇妙な規則です。規則が、席を朝まで守ります。
segments.en: In the night circle, Yelena does not lower the plan. The content she does not lower is that the march is the island's survival. She ties the name of survival to the contact of Zeke and Eren. Hange, continuing from the night of the breath, does not trust the smile that ties it. Yelena dismisses the question she does not trust as feeling. The attitude of dismissing lowers the circle's temperature once. Even at the temperature it lowers, she does not stand from the seat. The not standing is the strange rule of this night. The rule guards the seats until morning.

segments.titleEn: Magath speaks for the side that made them

segments.en: Magath admits that Marley is the side that made the warriors. The voice that admits has not become the shape of an apology. Without having become it, he says the march must be stopped. The reason he says it is that the weapons they made are trampling the world. Reiner receives the responsibility of trampling as a memory of his own body. The memory he receives is the towns he saw inside the Armor. He does not make those towns into a hero's story tonight. After the story he does not make, only the responsibility remains.

segments.titleJa: ミカサは殺すを受けない
segments.ja: ミカサは、夜が深まっても殺すという語を受けません。受けない理由は、方向を見ている相手が友だ、です。友を止める必要を、彼女は頭では否定し切れません。切れないまま、語だけを拒みます。拒む端を、ジャンは自分の矜持と並べます。並べる二人は、同じ痛みで別の速度です。速度が違っても、輪は彼女を追い出しません。出さないことが、この夜の規則の一つです。
segments.en: Even as the night deepens, Mikasa does not receive the word kill. The reason she does not receive it is that the person whose direction she is watching is a friend. She cannot fully deny, in her head, the need to stop the friend. Without being able to deny it, she refuses only the word. Jean lines the edge she refuses up with his own pride. The two who line it up are different speeds of the same pain. Even if the speeds differ, the circle does not drive her out. The not driving her out is one rule of this night.

segments.titleJa: アルミンは会話を残す
segments.ja: アルミンは、殺すの前に会話が一度でも届くかを問います。問う届き先は、始祖の部屋にいるエレンです。いるエレンが、地上の声を聞いている保証はありません。ない保証を、彼はそれでもゼロにはしません。しません。海の約束が、届くかもしれない最後の文だ、です。だ、を、輪は甘いとは笑いません。笑わない理由は、他の文も同じくらい細い、です。細い文を、輪は笑い飛ばしません。
segments.en: Armin asks whether a conversation can arrive even once before kill. The destination he asks about is Eren, who is in the Founder's room. There is no guarantee the Eren who is there is hearing voices on the ground. He still does not make the guarantee that is not there into zero. He does not. The promise of the sea is the last sentence that might arrive. The circle does not laugh at that as sweet. The reason it does not laugh is that the other sentences are just as thin. The circle does not laugh the thin sentences away.

segments.ja: 夜の後半で、港の名が出ます。出る名は、アズマビトの船がある場所です。ある船は、地上の足では追いつけない距離を飛ぶためのものです。ための詳細を、今日の話は手順にしません。しません。置くのは、届く手段がそこ以外に残っていない、です。残っていない事実を、ハンジが輪に置きます。置く事実は、決定ではなく、道の名前です。名前だけが、朝まで輪の中央に残ります。
segments.en: In the later half of the night, the name of the port comes out. The name that comes out is the place where the Azumabito ship is. The ship that is there is for flying a distance feet on the ground cannot catch. Today's story does not turn the detail of that for into a procedure. It does not. What it sets down is that no means of arriving remains except there. Hange sets the fact that does not remain into the circle. The fact she sets is not a decision. It is the name of a road. Only the name remains at the center of the circle until morning.

segments.ja: この夜は、挙手で終わりません。終わりません。終わらない代わりに、席を立たない人が残ります。残る人は、イェレナの計画を全部は共有していません。共有していないまま、行進を止める方向だけが共通です。共通の方向に、ミカサの拒む語がまだ刺さっています。刺さったまま、夜は白み始めます。白む空は、平和の色ではありません。ではない白さが、港の名を浮き上がらせます。
segments.en: This night does not end with a show of hands. It does not. In place of not ending, the people who do not leave their seats remain. The people who remain do not share the whole of Yelena's plan. Without sharing it, only the direction of stopping the march is common. Mikasa's refusing word is still stuck in the common direction. While it stays stuck, the night starts to whiten. The sky that whitens is not the color of peace. The whiteness that is not that lifts the port's name.

segments.en: Before it whitens, Jean adds only one sentence. The one sentence he adds is that the person who set down the plate will be on the port's side tomorrow. He does not make the side he will be on into a declaration of friendship. He does not. It is not increasing, any further, the seats where Sasha is absent. Reiner and Annie nod small in the direction of not increasing them. The nod is not a signature. It is not. It is the body's response to having passed the night. After the response, the port's name is spoken once more.

segments.en: The morning light does not make the circle into one army. It does not. Without making it, only the name of the port remains. Hange stands holding the name that remained, in place of a map. Beside the standing, Mikasa has still not received kill. The face that has not received it, and the feet turning toward the port, are on the same person. The night could not untie the contradiction that is there. The could not untie is the honest result of this night. Holding that result, the people look toward the port.

segments.en: Today's words. This night is the time they talked until morning about whether to stop a friend. Jean sets Sasha's plate at the center. Yelena says the march is survival.
